theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the single eligible trend theme with the strongest durability bar (0.87), hurst_tag 'trend', and broad participation (breadth 0.944). The crowding flag (z 1.98, one_narrative true) is a sizing caution only, not a fade. Given track_record dir_accuracy 0.337 and gate_helps false, this is a conditional continuation lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding is extreme and one-narrative concentration is fragile; the trend gate did not reduce drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so the very trend this leg highlights may whipsaw under China A-share regime shifts.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) closes below its 20-day moving average and stays below for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme (score 0.887) but its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' and breadth is thin at 0.2, indicating a narrow, unstable trend. With detector commentary explicitly warning not to treat ranks as a buy list and directional accuracy low, an avoid lean is more honest than chasing the challenger.
theses.dissent: Coal is the only challenger to Banks and has positive score; a mean-revert tag could simply mean it consolidates before continuing higher, and thin breadth can precede a powerful extension.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) closes above its recent 20-day high and holds that level for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.
